scope.fullVisualOrOfficeReview: Owned by native trial supervisor, not certified here

findings.issue: The title says most tools give an agent only a screenshot. Notes say the image-based loop is not something one can measure, compare or optimise and every check is a fresh guess. These categorical claims go beyond the author's experienced friction: pixel comparisons exist, while an image lacks the direct object-addressable structure that the new workflow offers. The same page correctly retains visual review for composition.

The concluding copy says a human point of view means the slides stop looking like AI. The author proposes story-first as the desired approach; this is not an established guarantee of perceived human authorship. It should be read as an aspiration rather than a measured or automatic result.

The page adds a simple video-editor-style timeline as an idea for later. It is correctly labelled future, not a shipped feature, but this was an unformed/deferred direction kept out by the shared story brief.

observations: The filename and edit examples on page 4 are explicitly labelled illustrations.
Page 9 correctly says PPTX has page parts and describes the PPTD page-file model as the same organizing idea rather than only a renamed entry.
Pages 16 and 22 distinguish review of saved operations from preview before applying a new transaction.
Scientific Notes correctly scope the 12 distances to paired positions in one deposited structure.
Story is explicitly described as the agent's interpretation rather than author approval.
limits: Semantic review of a frozen native submission only; author acceptance remains outstanding.
Claude visual material was not used as a reference for ChatGPT or DeepSeek.
Native completion, source/export integrity and Office layout are separately recorded by the trial supervisor.
